main_text.head: De sacris Imperatorum personis Ecclesiae primitivae decem persequutionibus.
LIBER II.
CAP. I.
De oboedientia Christianorum in Nero-nem, sub persequutione prima.
main_text.p: Ecenset {b}Divus Augustinus, & ex Augustino eius b Lib. 18. de civit.dei[?], cap. 52.discipulus {c}Orosius, decem fuisse, ut plagas in Aegypto, ita persequutiones in Ecclesia primi-c Lib. 7.

page.notes: The lower part of the page is an ornamental woodcut border, not text. The strip at the far left is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. "O si" is read with some doubt because the letters are close together. The woodcut initial R is joined to "ecenset" as "Ecenset" and the first letter is shown as E after the initial; the initial itself is a decorative block. The "dei" in the first marginal note is doubtful. The catchword "tiua" and the signature "F" are at the foot. The left strip of the scan is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
